answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use accountable vouching: a new identity gains weight only when established peers stake their own standing on it, and if the newcomer cheats, the vouchers lose standing too. Like a dune that only holds when its grasses root together, or a meadow whose health is judged by the whole field rather than one blade, trust becomes shared liability - an attacker must corrupt many reputable sponsors, not just echo one fake identity endlessly, and each fake costs real reputation.
